title: dracaena fragrans
intro: Dracaena fragrans, commonly known as the fragrant dracaena or corn plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asparagaceae. This plant is known for its air-purifying properties, and it has been reported to have various health benefits, including reducing stress and anxiety, promoting better sleep, and improving overall well-being due to its ability to remove air pollutants. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
